tenderSchedule.title: Operation & maintenance of Truck mounted road sweeping machine (6CUM) with lubricants, repair , Spares & comprehensive maintenance.(For 3 years)
tenderSchedule.description: Operation & maintenance of Truck mounted road sweeping machine (6CUM) with lubricants, repair , Spares & comprehensive maintenance.(For 3 years)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Rates should be quoted including taxes
All terms and condition as per bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the Truck Mounted Road Sweeping Machine or its authorized service provider and shall have successfully executed Operation and Comprehensive Maintenance (AMC) services of such machines or SWM Machines in at least one Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) during the last five years. The bidder shall submit work orders along with satisfactory performance certificates/completion certificates issued by the respective ULBs as proof of experience.

Tenderer firm/company should not be blacklisted by any government organization. The Tenderer shall furnish an Affidavit (for the current financial year) for not having Black Listed earlier by the Firm / Company represented by its Proprietor / Partners / Directors / Chairman / Managing Director / Office Bearers in the Business Transactions of any Government / Semi- Government / Government Undertaking / Public Sector Organizations / any other Departments.
The bidder shall have achieved an annual turnover of not less than Rs. 56.10 lakh in any two of the last five financial years 2021 to 22, 2022 to 23, 2023to 24, 2024to 25 and 2025 to 26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 15.18 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from any Scheduled banks for meeting the fund requirement etc). (Usually not less than 30% of the estimated cash flow) format as enclosed in Bid document (Unconditional and Irrevocable LOC should be submitted)

The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the Truck Mounted Road Sweeping Machine or an authorized service provider/dealer of the OEM. In case the bidder is not the OEM, a valid authorization letter issued by the OEM, specifically authorizing the bidder to undertake the Operation and Comprehensive Maintenance (AMC) services under this tender, shall be submitted along with the bid. The bidder should submit support letter for Spare parts and technical back-up from the OEM of the machine supplied to Shivamogga City Corporation.
The agency should be registered under companies act 2013/ partnership act/ sole proprietorship under relevant act.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Affidavit on stamp paper stating the firm is not Black listed by any government departments, agencies, Institutions
Authorization letter and support letter for Spare parts and technical back-up form the OEM
Work orders certificate issued from Government Department
